author: SickProdigy
description: Develop-only CryptoWallet connector with protected, default-off Polymarket trading workflows.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-user public Polymarket account and terms records, short-lived public challenges, optional encrypted session-key and CLOB-credential records with public provisioning, reconciliation, revocation, lifecycle, bounded retired-lifecycle history, and rotation state, Deposit Wallet deployment and Bridge funding records, immutable trade, cancellation, and withdrawal approvals, active order and digest-only withdrawal lifecycles, bounded order history, rolling spend reservations, confirmation preferences, and a bounded digest-only audit, plus installation-wide safety settings. It fetches identity-bound public portfolio data and authenticated balance and open-order data without persisting those responses. Session private keys are authenticated ciphertext bound to the user and wallet profile; production trading remains default-off.
install_msg: Polymarket is a develop-only connector to CryptoWallet. The account, session, deposit, trading, claim, and withdrawal flows are implemented and tested with simulated provider responses, but every production capability remains default-off and emergency-paused.
name: Polymarket
